summary: Completed frontend validation on desktop and mobile for homepage, navigation, catalogue filtering/search, quick enquiry, WhatsApp form, contact actions, section anchors, logo rendering, and mobile overflow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend critical flows passed at desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844. WhatsApp popup initially uses wa.me and resolves externally to api.whatsapp.com/send with encoded enquiry data, which is expected provider behavior.
rca of the issue: No actionable defects found. The WhatsApp URL assertion observed the provider redirect from wa.me to api.whatsapp.com after popup navigation; the phone number and all enquiry fields remained encoded in the resulting URL.
